@pcbeingused333 please check cubic P2 issue & missing tests

The cubic P2 is valid: the truthy `finish_reason` guard bypasses the mapper when the reason is missing or null. The closing fallback now infers `tool_use` from recorded tool calls, while explicit `length` and `content_filter` reasons remain unchanged. Added tests for both stream termination paths and the missing non-streaming cases. This changes one existing expectation: `finalize()` on a stream that emitted a tool call but no finish reason now reports `tool_use` instead of `end_turn`, including when the stream ends mid tool call. The `hasToolCalls` parameter of the stop-reason mapper no longer has an unused default, so the patch has no uncovered line.
